remarks:
WALK TO LAKE ERIE BEACH ACCESS! Enjoy the lake lifestyle, a large double corner lot, and move-in-ready updates at 9375 Jamestown St in Angola! This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home combines a desirable location with generous outdoor space, excellent storage and parking for up to four vehicles.

Step inside to find updated flooring and fresh paint creating a clean, refreshed feel throughout. A newer hot water tank provides another valuable update for the next owner. The spacious primary bedroom features a large walk-in closet, giving you plenty of room for clothing and additional storage. Two full baths add everyday convenience and flexibility.

Outside is where this property really stands out. The home sits on a large double lot extending to the corner, giving you extra room to relax, entertain, garden or enjoy outdoor activities. Two large 10' x 14' storage sheds provide exceptional space for lawn equipment, bicycles, tools, beach gear, seasonal items and more. A double-wide driveway accommodates up to four vehicles, making everyday parking and entertaining easy.

Best of all, Lake Erie beach access is within walking distance! Spend summer days near the water, take an evening stroll to the lake or enjoy the beautiful Lake Erie sunsets that make this area special. Whether you're searching for a year-round home, weekend retreat or simply want more space near the lake, this property offers a combination that's hard to overlook.

Lake access, a large double lot, updated interior, two full baths, abundant storage and plenty of parking—9375 Jamestown St checks a lot of boxes. Don't miss your opportunity to make it yours.
